milestone: SeLinOS root-constructed child completion witness M4

platform.configuration: SeLinRootConstructM1Adapter=ON; SeLinRootConstructM2ControlLease=ON; SeLinRootConstructM3SingleResume=ON; SeLinRootConstructM4Completion=ON; lower profiles remain separate

contract.topology: Only root allocates one completion endpoint and copies one cap into the fixed taskd completion slot and one cap into the fixed root-selected child completion slot before suspended spawn.
contract.action: Taskd validates M1/M2 provenance, resumes the M4-received child TCB exactly once, then accepts only the exact fixed completion record.
contract.witness: The M4 child prints one execution witness, sends exactly one `(CHILD_DONE, slot=1, generation=1)` message and only yields thereafter.

required_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: isolated taskd request endpoint ready.
SeLinOS root construction M1: exact fixed request accepted; root constructing.
SeLinOS root construction M1: one fixed child constructed and spawned suspended; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M1: malformed or duplicate request rejected; no allocation.
SeLinOS root construction M2: one constructed-child TCB control cap delivered; child remains suspended.
SeLinOS root construction M2: malformed, unavailable or duplicate lease rejected; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M4 taskd client: one received-child TCB resumed; waiting for completion.
SeLinOS root construction M4 completion child: executed after taskd resume.
SeLinOS root construction M4 completion child: one exact completion sent.
SeLinOS root construction M4 taskd client: exact one child completion validated.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS root construction M1: unable to start taskd adapter client.
SeLinOS root construction M1: fixed child construction failed; no cap delivered.
SeLinOS root construction M4 taskd client: M1/M2 provenance transaction rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M4 taskd client: received-child TCB resume rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M4 taskd client: child completion rejected.
SeLinOS root construction M4 completion child: unexpected execution.

not_claimed: general IPC namespace, endpoint rights policy, dynamic task allocation, process creation API, generic completion or supervision protocol, second cap transfer, second resume, suspend or scheduler control
child configuration after construction, IPC retry, arbitrary messages, filesystem, Linux ABI, credentials, namespaces, FD or TLS inheritance, device access or nested child creation
teardown, cleanup, delete, revoke, unmap, release, reuse, process exit, wait, signals or futex lifecycle
Linux clone, fork, pthread, executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading, dynamic linker semantics, glibc runtime, dpkg or apt
